associated_records.title: Utilities: roles, transactions and open accounting questions

selected_questions.question: What evidence supports a selected US electric utility's FERC regulatory-accounting route, and when is the same amount outside that route?
How should a selected electric utility reconcile metered, estimated and unbilled consumption at period end without treating a data mismatch as revenue?
What evidence connects utility plant construction costs to continuing plant records and separates an unsuccessful preliminary project?
Which evidence distinguishes a utility asset-retirement obligation from ordinary removal cost, and what must remain open for current accounting?
How should purchased power and related settlement amounts remain distinct from utility sales in the selected regulatory ledger?

selected_roles: FERC-jurisdictional electric public utility or licensee maintaining Part 101 records
Unregulated merchant generator or utility service provider as a scope counterexample
selected_scope.framework: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for the selected regulatory population, with a separate US GAAP financial-reporting review required before posting or filing
selected_scope.period: Illustrative 2026-12-31 close; source review performed 2026-09-19; future transactions are fictional
selected_scope.population: One electric utility billing, purchased-power, construction, regulatory-balance and retirement-obligation packet; gas, water/sewage, municipal and state-specific branches remain outside this package.
exclusions: No current consolidated ASC 980 or ASC 410 claim; those texts and entity-specific applicability were not read
No professional sign-off, operational transaction population, deployment evidence or measured agent performance
No source-level reuse permission is inferred from public access

dispositions.preserve: All existing records, linked questions, rights and historical evidence remain available.
dispositions.reuse: Use the accepted shared rate-regulation foundation and original FERC records; selected questions add electric-utility application.
dispositions.defer: Gas, water, sewage, municipal and state-specific expansion remains outside the selected FERC electric role; do not infer descendant sufficiency.
